Game Overview

In Chicken Dash, the core idea is straightforward: guide a speedy chicken through thrilling platformer challenges. Navigate spikes and gaps with perfect timing, while collecting coins for extra excitement. With each level, brace for increasing difficulty and adrenaline-pumping action. Can you master every jump and dash your way to victory?
